units.name: 折斧兵
units.visual: Stout paper infantry, broad square vermilion armor, folded axe, thick square stamp shield, earnest ivory face, short sturdy limbs.

units.name: 纸矛手
units.visual: Slimmer red-armored paper spear thrower, two folded javelins, pointed small helmet, forward throwing hand; distinct from melee shield infantry.

units.name: 压印锤卫
units.visual: Very wide stocky vermilion heavy guard, enormous rectangular stamp hammer with an abstract seal, thick pauldrons, concentrated funny face.

units.name: 卷轴炮车
units.visual: A short wheeled paper siege cart, folded scroll cannon barrel, vermilion printed frame, two simple cardboard wheels, absolutely no operator or real metal.

units.name: 运金纸工
units.visual: Small unarmored ivory paper worker with a red sash, round conical paper cap, tiny folded pick and visible gold-carrying satchel, gentle face.

units.name: 印甲统帅
units.visual: Proud paper general with broad vermilion armor, square stamp-shaped helmet crest, absurdly serious eyebrows, a tiny seal baton; no playable hero.

units.name: 墨刃猎兵
units.visual: Angular ink-black blade hunter, long folded arms, narrow pointed paper mask with ivory face, hooked paper blade, lively lean silhouette.

units.name: 墨针手
units.visual: Thin charcoal paper poison shooter with a narrow straw-paper hat, short ink blowpipe, tiny poison vial shape on belt, sharp eyes; no cloud effects.

units.name: 拾纸祭司
units.visual: Tall narrow ink-paper priest, ragged folded robe, skull-paper mask, one paperbone staff topped with a simple curled scrap, composed ritual expression.

units.name: 纸巨人
units.visual: Huge angular charcoal folded-paper giant with a rectangular ink-swirl mask, extremely broad jointed shoulders, hanging ivory paper strips and giant folded hands. Simple few polygon panels.

units.name: 拾金纸工
units.visual: Small ivory paper worker with charcoal sash, round conical paper cap, tiny folded pick and gold satchel, same base economic body size as other workers.

units.name: 纸骨兵
units.role: 消费阵亡标记后的召唤兵
units.visual: Small ivory skeleton-like paper soldier, flat skull mask with two black eye holes, three simple folded paperbone limb pieces, tiny paper knife. Non-anatomical funny fragile cutout.

units.name: 镜符刀卫
units.visual: Jade and dull-gold paper guard, fan-shaped folded helmet, curved paper blade, clearly visible round printed mirror shield, broad elegant silhouette.

units.name: 火签手
units.visual: Jade paper ranged soldier with small winged cap, a short folded launcher holding two red paper fire-slips, gold printed trim, angular cheerful face, no flame effect.

units.name: 折影客
units.visual: Narrow jade charcoal paper infiltrator with folded hood and fan tail sash, two short paper blades, crouched-ready but neutral complete-body pose, no transparency.

units.name: 厚纸俑
units.visual: Sturdy thick layered ivory paper effigy guard, jade rectangular plates, dull-gold seal crest, simple stiff face and long paper polearm, visibly thicker cutout edge.

units.name: 灯金纸工
units.visual: Small ivory paper worker with jade sash, round conical paper cap, tiny folded pick and gold satchel, same proportions as red and ink workers.

units.name: 护符纸卫
units.visual: Ivory and jade summoned paper guardian with a large circular abstract seal on chest, broad flat fan headdress and blunt seal staff, no glow, no letters, no magic effects.

units.name: 墨骸统帅
units.visual: A comically self-important tall ink-black paper commander, angular ivory half-mask revealing one raised eyebrow, broad pointed paper collar, three small red seal strips, paperbone baton and a folded hood. Full body, very simple large paper panels, ritual personality, never a playable hero.

units.name: 灯符统帅
units.visual: A smug but humorous jade paper commander, oversized fan-shaped dull-gold paper crown, broad folded sleeves, round seal pendant, one folded hand fan and confidently arched eyebrows. Full body, clearly thin articulated paper panels, never a playable hero.
